name: 7051-decodeheavy-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one in-process vLLM engine driven by guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=512, warmup the first 25% by request count, bounded at 10240 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets. Prompt exactly 128 tokens (min = max), output exactly 512 (min = max); the `vllm_python` backend sets `ignore_eos` with `max_tokens`, so every request generates exactly 512 tokens. `request_format: plain` in scenario.json is required, not stylistic -- the base checkpoint has no chat template for `apply_chat_template` to use.
purpose: A long-form text generation service on one GPU, writing 512-token completions from short prompts for 512 concurrent users.
launch:
# The engine's command line at commit 6a11fdfbb8d6701c7ad38648aead23d8cbe6aac5.
# This era's AsyncEngineArgs takes an unknown key as a TypeError at engine construction:
# do not add keys from a later vLLM.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B

# Must move together with `streams: 512` in scenario.json -- at max-num-seqs 256 the client
# would simply queue and the declared operating point would not exist.
max-num-seqs: 512
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enforce-eager: false
enable-prefix-caching: false
use-v2-block-manager: false
enable-chunked-prefill: false
